findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_mindfulness_resources, find_mindfulness_games, find_podcast_episodes · Private data: get_mindfulness_resource, find_panchavikas_resources · Public sink: search_mindfulness_resources, find_mindfulness_games.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_mindfulness_resources, find_mindfulness_games, find_podcast_episodes · Private data: get_mindfulness_resource, find_panchavikas_resources · Public sink: search_mindfulness_resources, find_mindfulness_games

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_mindfulness_resources" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
